title: Homework: A Context Document for an Unfamiliar Module
objective: Write a context document for a module you have not seen, use it to generate a grace-period feature, and check the generated feature against the cases the document must support.
expected:
days 0 -> 0 pass
days 1 -> 0 pass
days 4 -> 25 pass
days 200 -> 2000 pass
days -1 -> error pass
